# FloatingToolbar

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:floating-toolbar` · Kerf UI · component · Structure

## When to use

A transparent, forced-dark toolbar that floats over its container's content.

- Float a small cluster of controls (e.g. a drawer restore) over scrolling content without covering dialogs.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for a primary page or panel toolbar, or for anything that must sit above overlays (it is not top-layer).

**Alternatives:**

- [Toolbar](./toolbar.md) (nearest)

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/floating-toolbar` — exports `FloatingToolbar`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/floating-toolbar` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/floating-toolbar.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/floating-toolbar`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuifloating-toolbar) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

- `inset`: length grammar; raw values: forbid; helpers `px`, `rem`, `em`, `pct`, `space`, `lengthVar`, `calc` — e.g. `inset={space("xs")}`

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** controls; position; visibility.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: child · padding: child (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Give the toolbar an accessible name (label is required — it exposes role="toolbar").

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-floating-toolbar`.

Never put `kui-floating-toolbar` on an element you write; render `FloatingToolbar` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-floating-toolbar-inset`, `--kui-floating-toolbar-inset-block-start`, `--kui-floating-toolbar-inset-block-end`, `--kui-floating-toolbar-inset-inline-start`, `--kui-floating-toolbar-inset-inline-end`, `--kui-space-m`, `--kui-space-xs`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
